content: Before taking norethindrone, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. This medication may cause dizziness. Consuming alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities that require alertness until you are certain you can perform them safely. Limit your intake of alcoholic beverages. This medication may lead to blotchy, dark areas on your face and skin, a condition known as melasma. Sunlight can worsen this effect. Minimize your exposure to sunlight, and avoid using tanning booths or sunlamps. This medication should not be used during pregnancy. It is known to pass into breast milk. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs as well as herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Certain medications can affect the removal of norethindrone from your body, potentially altering its effectiveness. Examples include azole antifungals (such as itraconazole) and rifamycins (such as rifampin or rifabutin). This medication may interfere with certain laboratory tests, potentially causing inaccurate results. If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. While taking this medication, regular physical exams, including laboratory and/or medical tests (such as blood pressure checks, breast exams, pelvic exams, and Pap smears), should be conducted. Follow your doctor’s instructions for self-examining your breasts and report any lumps immediately. Keep all medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. It is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
